programme.desc: 'S3/E3'. Sbu and his guests find amusement in some wild engine sounds, before discovering that all the good, and the crazy, happens at home sweet home, featuring Caliva and That Boi Eon.

programme.title: IGNITION GT
programme.desc: 'S26/E39'. Juliet drives Kia's second generation Seltos. We find out if the GWM Ora 5 can make its mark on the local EV market and Zee gets better acquainted with the all-electric BMW iX2.

programme.title: Cape Route Rally
programme.desc: 'S4/E1'. Welcome back to a new season of Cape Route Rally, where the roads get rough, & anything can happen. It's not just about getting from A to B, so let the adventure begin!

programme.title: Just To See How Far It Is
programme.desc: 'S3/E16'. We wrap up the season with another gathering, exploring Stutterheim and the beautiful surrounds like old Thomas historical village, the shire eco lodge and the incredible Gubu dam.
